While the agent did correctly use the OnDemand EC2 rate (not Reserved) and correctly priced the EBS volume ($65.70 + $2.70), the core DynamoDB calculation is wrong relative to the expected reasoning, leading to a wrong final total. The agent did flag the free-tier ambiguity in caveats and even computed the alternative paid-tier total (~$13.14, close to the expected $2.19+$10.95=$13.14), but it did not commit to this as the actual answer, instead reporting $68.40 as the total. Given the expected final net figure is ≈$81.54 and the agent's primary reported figure is $68.40, this fails to match the expected output's key numerical conclusion.</reasoning>
